newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread marked higher in short squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread marked higher in short squeeze.

text.p: Shares in Whitbread Plc rose on Thursday after a big buyer of the stock late Wednesday left market-makers short of stock, traders said.
Whitbread shares were up 6-1/2p at 773p in thin volume of 430659 shares by 0950 GMT.

Dealers pointed out that Bass Plc holds its annual general meeting at 1200 GMT. "Nobody wants to be short ahead of the meeting," one trader said. "There's not much liquidity in Whitbread, so any buying activity shifts the price up."
Shares in Bass Plc were down 1p at 851-1/2 by 0950 GMT while Scottish & Newcastle Plc were up 1p at 666-1/2.
